novel_features.name: ACWR dashboard
novel_features.description: Instant acute:chronic workload ratios for any athlete or the full squad, color-coded into safe (0.8-1.3), caution, and danger (>1.5) zones.
novel_features.rationale: Requires 28 days of per-athlete load history rolled into 7d/28d windows — a local-SQLite computation the stats API cannot express.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked who is at injury risk or for the morning workload check.

novel_features.name: Weekly load report
novel_features.description: One-command weekly summary — total Player Load, session count, ACWR, max velocity vs PB, monotony, strain, and risk flags — exportable as markdown or CSV.
novel_features.rationale: Composes ACWR and PB internals over the local mirror into a coach-ready artifact; saves the Monday morning data wrangle.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a coach briefing or weekly load summary is requested.

novel_features.name: Personal bests
novel_features.description: Compares recent session values against each athlete's all-time or rolling personal best, with readiness % and 3-session trend arrows.
novel_features.rationale: SQL window functions over the athlete's full local stats history; the API has no personal-best concept.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before deciding who trains at full intensity today.

novel_features.name: Session diff
novel_features.description: Side-by-side comparison of two sessions (by ID, date, or last/prev) showing absolute and percentage change per metric and per athlete.
novel_features.rationale: Self-joins two local stats slices on athlete+metric — the export-and-pivot Excel chore, mechanized.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to diagnose travel fatigue and fixture congestion between consecutive matches.

novel_features.name: Positional benchmark
novel_features.description: Ranks any athlete against positional peers for a metric: percentile rank, squad median, and position median with outlier flags.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the full squad's local history joined to athlete positions; the stats engine groups but cannot rank.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after match debriefs to answer how an athlete compares to peers.

novel_features.name: Return-to-play tracker
novel_features.description: Tracks an injured athlete's load progression session-by-session as a percentage of squad average or a pre-injury baseline window.
novel_features.rationale: Combines two local aggregations (athlete series vs concurrent squad average or --baseline window) that no single API call provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when managing return-to-play decisions to give medical staff quantitative progression data.

novel_features.name: Period intensity heatmap
novel_features.description: Renders an athlete-by-period intensity matrix for a session — ANSI heatmap on a terminal, JSON matrix for agents — surfacing where fatigue compounded.
novel_features.rationale: Pivots period-grouped local stats into a shaped matrix; the API returns rows, not shape.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after matches to diagnose second-half performance drops.

narrative.headline: Every Catapult GPS metric — ACWR, velocity benchmarks, load reports — from one command, with a local SQLite mirror for offline analysis.
narrative.value_prop: catapult-openfield-connect-pp-cli syncs your OpenField data into a local SQLite store and unlocks computations the API cannot do alone: 28-day ACWR dashboards, personal velocity bests, session diffs, and positional benchmarks — all scriptable, pipeable, and agent-native. What used to require a custom R script now takes one command.
narrative.auth_narrative: OpenField Connect accepts a long-lived API token (create one in OpenField under API Tokens) sent as a Bearer header. Set CATAPULT_TOKEN in your environment or run auth set-token. Regional hosts differ: this CLI defaults to the Americas host (us.catapultsports.com); override base_url in config for APAC/EMEA tenants.

quickstart.comment: Verify config and connectivity without touching the API
Mirror the roster, metric catalog, and a month of sessions locally
The morning check: who is in the caution or danger zone
Find exact metric slugs before building a stats query
Monday coach briefing in one command

troubleshoots.fix: Token expired or wrong region host — regenerate the API token in OpenField and confirm base_url matches your tenant region
Check parameter slugs with 'search --type parameters' — slugs, not display names, are required
These read the local mirror: run 'sync --resources activities,athletes,parameters --since 30d' first

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for any Catapult OpenField data task: pulling session stats, checking squad ACWR, comparing matches, generating load reports, or giving an agent access to athlete GPS data without manual OpenField exports. It is the only CLI surface for OpenField; the alternative is the catapultR R package or the web UI.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to create, update, or delete anything in OpenField — it is read-only by design
Do not use it for live in-session streaming telemetry; it reads completed activity data
Do not use it for video or tactical analysis — OpenField carries GPS/accelerometer data only
